headline: Public hearings on Peace Dale Preserve zoning changes, Harbor Management Plan, and a Max's Chophouse liquor license transfer.
summary: The proposed Peace Dale Preserve zoning would allow overnight guest rentals, a restaurant with alcohol, and an indoor sports facility at 371 Rose Hill Road. Other business includes an EMS billing contract at 4% of collections and a $80,492.00 bell tower roof replacement at Town Hall.
items: Interviews with six candidates for boards and committees
Appointment to a board or committee, name and term blank on agenda
Consent agenda: $6,770.14 tax abatement
Consent agenda: $12,330 audio-visual purchase for Peace Dale Library multipurpose room
Consent agenda: up to $17,600 sidewalk trip hazard removal contract
Consent agenda: about 60 business license renewals
Public hearing: zoning amendments for Peace Dale Preserve at 371 Rose Hill Road
Public hearing: Harbor Management Plan update dated July 2026
Public hearing: transfer of Class B liquor license from Chophouse Grille to Max's Chophouse
Public hearing: renewal of liquor licenses starting December 1, 2026
Plaque honoring EMS Captain Frank Capaldi
Liquor license limits by class, Section I of rules
EMS billing contract with Comstar, LLC at 4% of collections, 2027 to 2030
Contract amendment with Key Corporation for electrical conduit, up to $400,459.95
Town Hall bell tower roof replacement with Martone Service Co., up to $80,492.00
Letter to CRMC objecting to pier project for RIDEM Commercial Fisheries Laboratory
Traffic-calming measures on Middlebridge Road
Open Meetings Act guidance for public comment
Town Manager update on South Road and Wakefield Elementary Schools demolition
Town Manager update on RIDOT Route 138 project and Amtrak bridge
Town Solicitor update on short-term rental regulation
Email from Jordan Banick requesting timed pedestrian crossings and a one-way Mechanic Street
Public comment, 30 minutes, continued later in the meeting
location: Town Council Chambers, 180 High Street, Wakefield, RI

8. Public Comment - 30 Minutes 
Rule 10A. for the conduct of the meetings of the South Kingstown Town Council: Members 
of the public shall be entitled to speak at regular meetings during any period designated on 
the agenda for public comment, once, for a period of five minutes, or longer at the 
discretion of the President, and at other times when invited to do so by the President. The 
public shall address their comments to the question under debate as indicated on the 
agenda. Pursuant to RI General Laws §42-46-6(b), public comment regarding subject
Posted on 11/19/2026 
matter not on the agenda but received during the public participation portion of a meeting 
shall be for information purposes only and may not be voted on except where necessary to 
address an unexpected occurrence that requires immediate action to protect the public or 
to refer the matter to an appropriate committee or to another body or official. 
9. Public Hearings 
 A. A Public Hearing to consider proposed amendments to the Zoning Ordinance 
and Zoning Map proposed by Applicant/Owner BWJW, LLC. The proposed map 
and text amendments would create a new zoning district known as the Peace 
Dale Preserve Special Management District and would apply to the property 
known as Peace Dale Preserve, located at 371 Rose Hill Road, also known as 
Assessor’s Map 33, Lot 30, as attached. The amendments would establish 
certain uses as permitted by right on the property, subject to certain limitations. 
Permitted uses would include both uses that are currently existing on the 
property, such as clay shooting / bow & arrow range, and would also include 
other uses such as overnight guest rentals, a restaurant with alcohol, and an 
indoor sports facility. The proposed amendments also include dimensional 
requirements and architectural standards that would apply to future development 
of the property. 
 B. A Public Hearing relative to adoption of the update to the Harbor Management 
Plan dated July 2026, a copy of which is viewable on the Town's website at: 
https://www.southkingstownri.gov/DocumentCenter/View/23302/Draft-Harbor-
Management-Plan_July-2026 or in the Office of the Town Clerk. 
 C. A Public Hearing relative to an application for transfer of a license to keep and 
sell alcoholic beverages in South Kingstown in accordance with the General 
Laws of 1956, as amended, as follows: 
 
CLASS B VICTUALER LIQUOR LICENSE 
 
Transfer of a Class B Victualer Liquor License from The Chophouse Inc. d/b/a 
Chophouse Grille, 191 Old Tower Hill Road, Wakefield, RI 02879 by Russell 
Goyette, Owner, to Acqua Pazza LLC d/b/a Max’s Chophouse, by Esther 
Dequattro, Member, for the main and private dining rooms and bar area; and as 
further defined in a site plan on file in the Town Clerk's office. 
 D. A Public Hearing relative to the renewal of Liquor Licenses for the year beginning 
December 1, 2026. Said licenses are granted contingent upon the issuance of a 
Certificate of Good Standing from the Rhode Island Division of Taxation, 
issuance of a Certificate of Insurance evidencing required liability coverage, 
compliance with all Town Ordinances and regulations, the payment of any 
municipal taxes, user fees and lease payments in arrears to the Town, and the 
correction of any fire code violations.
